brief:
British sanctions targeting illegal Israeli settlements are already producing measurable effects in the West Bank, even as most planned measures remain unimplemented, Middle East Eye reported. The sanctions regime has begun to constrain economic activity tied to settlement enterprises despite the bulk of restrictions still awaiting implementation.

The timing of the impact—preceding full enforcement of the sanctions framework—suggests that advance notice of restrictions has prompted behavioral changes among businesses and investors with exposure to settlement-linked commerce. British officials have framed the sanctions as part of efforts to pressure Israel over settlement expansion in occupied Palestinian territory.
dek: How British sanctions are already having a material impact in the West Bank British sanctions targeting illegal Israeli settlements already appear to be having a material impact, even though most of the planned measures have yet to come into force.
title: British sanctions on Israeli settlements show early impact in West Bank
